instruction: Turn up the system sound to 80% of maximum capacity.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep '^[[:space:]]Volume:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g'

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to set system volume to 80%. Evaluator uses pactl command to check volume percentage, expecting '80\n' output. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter - no custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Verified that pactl command returns volume percentage as integer (0-100) followed by newline. Volume 80% produces output '80\n'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts system volume percentage using pactl command
Metric comparison appropriately uses exact_match to verify volume is exactly 80%
Expected value '80\n' correctly matches the instruction requirement of 80% volume
Data flow is semantically correct: command extracts volume → exact_match compares → returns pass/fail
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The command assumes pactl output format is stable (field 5 contains percentage). This is generally reliable but could be made more robust with additional parsing validation.
Minor: Using head -n 1 assumes the first sink is the correct one to check. For multi-sink systems, this might need clarification, though it's reasonable for typical setups.
